intro: The Genesys V2 bedside table combines sleek modern aesthetics with practical storage, delivering a compact yet functional design. Crafted with care, it’s your daily essentials’ perfect partner.

features.title: Smart storage, always within reach
features.text: Stay organised effortlessly with a spacious drawer and an open shelf, ideal for storing all your bedtime essentials within easy reach.

features.title: Storage the customises to your needs
features.text: Engineered wood construction ensures durability and strength, promising a reliable addition to your living space.

features.title: Versatile two-tier storage

features.title: Compact yet functional
features.text: Perfect for smaller spaces, it balances space-saving dimensions with ample storage, making it versatile and practical.

features.title: Low maintenance and easy to care
features.text: With stain-resistant lamination, cleaning is a breeze, ensuring your bedside table looks impeccable for years to come.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
